posts.name: DeadlyKitten
posts.cooked:
I like ChatGPT. I use it a lot. It’s a good tool to ask computer questions. If I ask it code questions, 90% of the time it’s first guess is wrong. But you tell it that it’s wrong, and it says “Oh, right, my bad” and comes back with a correct solution.

It’s nice that it tailors the results to, more or less, precisely what you ask rather than finding some random question that’s sorta maybe almost close that you have to clean up to fit your use case.
